title: Independent Data-Integrity Verification for LLM-Driven Functional Coverage Closure in Hardware Design
title_zh: 独立数据-完整性验证 for LLM-驱动的功能覆盖闭合在硬件设计中的应用

paragraphs.en: 一种基于LLM的智能体被应用于硬件设计的测试中，以提升覆盖度并验证数据完整性。 LLM agents can write directed tests that close functional coverage, but coverage only shows that a state was reached, not that the data on the way there was correct. This is a long-known point in verification and we do not claim it as new. We describe a small coverage-closure agent that applies it to an LLM loop: coverage is read from the report that the simulation itself exports (cocotb-coverage YAML) and never taken from the model's account, and data integrity is checked by scoreboards that are separate from the model. On three architecturally distinct RTL designs (an asynchronous FIFO, a UART transmitter and an AHB2APB bridge) the agent raised coverage from 91.7%, 88.9% and 67.4% to 100% within its 8-iteration budget in every logged run, using one design-agnostic agent. A reactive scoreboard monitor attached to the FIFO's base testbench also found a clock-domain-crossing bug in the author's own stimulus code. The monitor is not yet attached to the LLM-generated tests, so their data integrity is not independently checked; one manual check on a single FIFO test is reported as preliminary. We list the weaknesses of this evidence: three designs, no baseline, no ablation, and logged runs that come from several agent checkpoints.
paragraphs.zh: 一种基于LLM的智能体被应用于硬件设计的测试中，以提升覆盖度并验证数据完整性。LLM智能体能够编写定向测试来闭合功能覆盖度，但覆盖度只能表明某个状态被到达，并不能证明在到达该状态的过程中数据是正确的。 这一点在验证领域由来已久，我们并不声称它是新观点。 我们描述一个应用该原则于LLM循环的小型覆盖度闭合智能体：覆盖度从仿真自身导出的报告中读取（cocotb-coverage YAML），绝不采信模型的自述，而数据完整性则由独立于模型的记分板来检查。 在三个架构上各不相同的RTL设计（一个异步FIFO、一个UART发送器和一个AHB2APB桥）上，该智能体使用同一个与设计无关的智能体，在其8轮迭代的预算内，在每一次有日志记录的运行中都将覆盖度从91.7%、88.9%和67.4%提升至100%。 一个挂接在FIFO基础测试平台上的响应式记分板监视器还在作者自己编写的激励代码中发现了一个跨时钟域缺陷。 该监视器尚未挂接到LLM生成的测试上，因此这些测试的数据完整性未经过独立检查；针对单个FIFO测试的一次人工检查仅作为初步结果报告。 我们列出这一证据的不足之处：设计数量仅三个、无基线对比、无消融实验，且有日志记录的运行来自多个智能体检查点。
